item.title: Show HN: AI search for every photo and every frame of video on macOS
item.description:
📝 The tap's cask clears the macOS quarantine flag automatically on every install and upgrade, so the app launches with no manual Gatekeeper steps: brew tap allenv0/scm brew trust allenv0/scm brew install --cask allenv0/scm/scm Upgrades keep the same behavior: brew upgrade --cask allenv0/scm/scm Prefer least privilege. Trust just the cask instead of the whole tap: brew tap allenv0/scm brew trust --cask allenv0/scm/scm brew install --cask scm The tap lives at allenv0/homebrew-scm. It bundles the fresh dist/ bundle together with main.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/allenv0/SCM
